weapon.d: Grants Spd+3. At start of ally's combat, if unit is within 2 spaces of any allies with Def > unit's Def, grants Atk/Spd+4 to those allies during combat. At start of unit's combat, if unit is not within 2 spaces of any allies with Def > unit's Def, grants Atk/Spd+6 to unit during combat.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+6 during combat.

b.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.
Neutralizes effects that guarantee foe's follow-up attacks and effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, grants Def+2 to ally with the highest Def for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
At start of turn, grants Def+4 to ally with the highest Def for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
At start of turn, grants Def+6 to ally with the highest Def for 1 turn. (Excludes unit.)
